title: Why most leads forget you exist by week 3
summary: The AI email strategy that keeps your brand top-of-mind with 500 leads at once — 12 recipients

payload.subject: Why most leads forget you exist by week 3
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Confession: most of the leads sitting in your CRM right now have already forgotten who you are.


Not because they weren't interested.


Because nobody followed up after the first message.


Quick qualifier before I keep going.


If you're already sending a real weekly or monthly touch to your full lead list — skip this one, you're already doing it.


But if the last thing most of your leads heard from you was the day they first reached out, keep reading.


Here's the old way.


One follow-up. Maybe two. Then the lead goes cold and gets written off.


The AI Growth Engine's way is different.


It keeps every lead in your pipeline — not just the ones actively replying — hearing from you on a steady rhythm, automatically, without you writing a single extra message.


One independent training studio owner switched from “follow up once, then nothing” to a simple recurring note to their full list.


Nothing flashy. No new offer.


Within a few weeks, replies started coming in from leads who'd gone quiet months earlier.


Not because the pitch changed.


Because someone was still showing up in their inbox when they were finally ready to book.


That's the whole idea behind The AI Growth Engine: your pipeline stays warm on its own, so every lead you've ever collected is still working for you months later — not just the ones from this week.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}?


Book a quick discovery call.


Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just 20 minutes to see if a simple nurture system would actually move the needle for {{business_name}}.


Unsubscribe
